create_step3p5_mtp_model: create a Step3p5MTP multi-token prediction model from a VllmConfig for speculative decoding
build_mtp_predictor_layer: build a Step3p5AMultiTokenPredictorLayer that normalizes and projects input embeddings with previous hidden states
run_mtp_forward_pass: run the forward pass of Step3p5AMultiTokenPredictor with input ids, positions, and hidden states
compute_mtp_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the MTP shared head and logits processor
load_mtp_weights: load checkpoint weights into a Step3p5MTP model with stacked and expert parameter mapping
